QUESTION:
What is the default value of `replicator.max_retries`?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0900] config | snapshotter.max_retries | version 4.x
# `snapshotter.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `snapshotter.max_retries` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
max_retries = 10
```

---

[d0859] config | replicator.max_connections | version 4.x
# `replicator.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `4096` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | connections |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `replicator.max_connections` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
max_connections = 4096
```

---

[d0878] config | replicator.max_connections (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `replicator.max_connections` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1024` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | connections |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `replicator.max_connections` only if you observe problems with the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
max_connections = 1024
```

---

# `scheduler.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | scheduler |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `scheduler.max_retries` only if you observe problems with the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
max_retries = 5
```
